title: 1 Timothy Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 1 Timothy 2: prayer for all people, the one mediator, and the instructions for men and women at prayer.

questions.text: For whom are petitions, prayers, intercessions and thanks to be made?
questions.explanation: Verses 1 and 2 say they are to be made for all men, for kings and all who are in high places.

questions.text: What is the purpose of praying for kings and those in high places?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says it is so that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

answers.text: That the kings may be saved from war
That the law may be read in every city
That the assembly may grow in number
That we may lead a tranquil and quiet life

questions.text: What does God our Savior desire, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says he desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

answers.text: That the Gentiles keep the law
That the nations fear his name
That every city hear the prophets

questions.text: Who is named as the one mediator between God and men?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.

questions.text: What did he give himself as, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says he gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony in its own times.

questions.text: What was the writer appointed, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says he was appointed a preacher and an apostle, a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

questions.text: How are the men in every place to pray?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he desires that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

answers.text: Kneeling in the house of prayer
Lifting up holy hands, without anger

questions.text: With what are women to adorn themselves, rather than with gold, pearls or expensive clothing?
questions.explanation: Verses 9 and 10 say they should adorn themselves with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

questions.text: Who was formed first, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says Adam was formed first, then Eve.

questions.text: Who was deceived, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says Adam wasn't deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience.
